report:
Reviewed the complete meta.book.authority claim and both implementation/test entries. Source inspection: spec.rs load_workspace builds its published inventory from SUMMARY and crate chapters, uses normative() to admit Design while excluding Tenets, historical material and generated anchor pages, and diagnoses unpublished Design Markdown and Sage sources. Markdown and Sage prose both enter add_chapter_text, which preserves source file/spans, assigns chapter context URLs (and Sage entity context), and rejects duplicate names. This supports canonical Design authority, equal source-format standing, identifiable definitions and separation of generated appearances from definitions. This is not a claim of complete end-to-end rendering verification.

The ordinary canonical_inventory_uses_configured_chapters_and_local_names test visibly asserts exactly the two intended Design anchors despite Tenets/RFD markers, no diagnostics, three normative documents, the chapter namespace, and the source-context URL. Captured BookFixture setup uses a configured manual source root and invokes load_workspace, so those assertions exercise actual inventory selection. It would catch accidental inclusion of the historical markers. The TODO implementation region and design_chapters_are_canonical test in spec_plan.rs explicitly defer the full Design-only/single-definition generated-copy scenario; the empty stub is not behavioral coverage. Completing that deferral requires integrated fixtures with authoritative Markdown/Sage definitions and generated appearances, asserting one source definition and retained source context across generation. Existing source logic and partial assertions justify retaining the explicit TODO, without claiming the missing full scenario tested or implemented end to end.

Baseline verification: both implementation files and spec_plan test source exactly match the supplied historical snapshots. The sole spec.rs test-file delta migrates a different test's review-input claim accessor to fragments; the associated authority test and fixture behavior are unchanged. I independently reassessed the prior rationale against current claim, associations, full implementation context and complete associated tests. Execution: I ran review start, review read, and exact source comparisons; no behavioral tests/build were run by me. The coordinator's reported 321 passing tests and root build are separate reported evidence. No requested edits; TODO remains deferred.
